title: Towards User Simulators That Stay On Task And Still Sound Natural
abstract: arXiv:2610.31512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Users increasingly rely on AI systems for extended, multi-turn tasks, yet evidence indicates that LLM-based system performance degrades over prolonged interaction. To evaluate and improve AI assistants in such settings, we need user simulators that faithfully follow complex user intents while exhibiting realistic conversational behavior. Existing approaches manifest a trade-off: prompted assistants can follow complex user intents but lack behavioral fidelity, while specialized user simulators better approximate conversational behavior but struggle to remain faithful to complex intents. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that jointly rewards task intent adherence and behavioral naturalness. A crucial contribution of the method is operationalizing naturalness with a lightweight discriminator trained in an alternating, adversarial loop with the user simulator. translated_title: 构建既忠于任务又听感自然的用户模拟器
translated_abstract: 用户越来越依赖AI系统完成长时间的多轮任务，然而有证据表明，基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统在长期交互中性能会逐渐下降。为了在此类场景中评估和改进AI助手，我们需要既能忠实遵循复杂用户意图、又能展现真实对话行为的用户模拟器。现有方法存在一种权衡：通过提示实现的助手可以遵循复杂的用户意图，但缺乏行为保真度；而专门设计的用户模拟器虽能更好地逼近真实对话行为，却难以忠实于复杂意图。本文提出了一种强化学习（RL）方法，同时奖励任务意图遵循度和行为自然度。该方法的一个关键贡献是通过一个轻量级判别器以交替对抗循环的方式与用户模拟器共同训练，从而将“自然度”进行可操作化定义。我们发布了由此训练得到的模型 UserLM-2.0。
tldr: 本文提出一种强化学习方法，通过在交替对抗循环中训练轻量级判别器来将行为自然度可操作化，从而同时奖励任务意图遵循与对话自然度，并发布了由此得到的用户模拟器模型 UserLM-2.0。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an RL recipe that jointly rewards task intent adherence and behavioral naturalness by operationalizing naturalness with a lightweight discriminator trained in an alternating adversarial loop, releasing the resulting user simulator model UserLM-2.0.
